features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum detector (36) attached to the gripper-side suction line section (12b), which monitors the vacuum level in the sealed region.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.note: The reference describes warning means that generate a warning signal when the electrical control device is switched off and a vacuum above a predetermined threshold is present in the gripper-side suction line section. This implies activation when the vacuum falls to or below this threshold.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
